items.narrative: The echoes of legend reverberate throughout the land as you stand victorious over the lifeless form of Azrok, the Ancient Red Dragon! Your axe, once imbued with the fire of the depths, now shines brighter than the sun itself, its blade etched with the tales of a thousand bravest deeds. The whispers of the ancients, which once spoke only of your name in awe, now speak of you as a champion, a warrior who has vanquished the very fabric of darkness itself. Your people, the Dwarves of old, shall tell this tale for ages to come, and the world shall tremble at the mention of Thorin's unyielding might.

As you delve deeper into the heart of Moria, the shadows seem to grow longer and darker, as if the very presence of your axe has stirred the slumbering guardians of the ancient halls. You feel an unseen force drawing you towards a hidden chamber, where the whispers of the past converge with the present. And then, you see it: Glamdring, the Foe-hammer, its blade shining like a shard of starlight in the dim light. The sword's presence seems to hum with an otherworldly energy, as if the ancient Dwarves who forged it have imbued it with their very essence. You sense that this is no ordinary sword, but a wielder's companion, forged for the one who would vanquish the shadows and bring hope back to a world beset by darkness.
